gen-fs-pramukh-rounded-gf-major-mono-dis: Major Mono Display glows like neon glass, its monospace letters spaced far apart. Pramukh Rounded sits above in tight, friendly sans forms with big lowercase, so the two read like a hum against a whisper, dense on top and drifting below.
gen-fs-quilon-fs-trench-slab: Quilon opens with a commanding editorial voice, its stroke swelling and thinning in a restrained rhythm. Trench Slab follows in a classic serif that keeps caps and lowercase close in height, so paragraphs read dignified and compact.
gen-fs-rajdhani-gf-kiwi-maru: Kiwi Maru reads like a traditional text serif, with generous letterspace and round, ringlike o shapes. Rajdhani above it keeps every curve as thick as a stem, so its dense modern strips sit against that looser, gentler texture.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-marcellus-sc: Marcellus SC reads tall and literary, a classic serif whose lowercase carries the stature of cast iron capitals. Red Hat Display is best at marker-like boldness with no shading, but Marcellus SC does its finest work through mild stress in the o and e.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-scope-one: Bold and contemporary, Red Hat Display draws one marker-like line with no swelling or thinning anywhere. Scope One then settles in as a classic serif, its big x-height and stubby ascenders giving the page a sturdier, more traditional footing.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-slabo-13px: Marker-bold and bright up top. Slabo 13px sits below as a bookish serif with open counters, while Red Hat Display holds a single line width, so the heading feels contemporary and the text feels dignified.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-aclonica: Aclonica reads as a long, stretched line of widely spaced letters with a deep lowercase midsection. Aclonica stays a plain sans with stems only slightly heavier than hairlines, so text moves along smoothly beneath Autour One's bold, expressive display shapes.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-ibm-plex-sans-th: IBM Plex Sans Thai Looped has curves that refuse to close. Balsamiq Sans brings bold, stencil-like weight with no pinched curves, so beside that open sans the two feel loud and quiet, each a distinct temperament.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-noto-sans-canadi: Noto Sans Canadian Aboriginal stays open at every curve end. Its plain sans calm against Balsamiq Sans, whose round bowls never swell or thin, is the strongest quality here: a bold, expressive heading over a quietly contemporary body.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-spinnaker: Expressive and bold, Balsamiq Sans keeps its weight constant along every curve. Spinnaker, a plain sans with apertures that keep counters connected to the outside, gives that energy a modern, open partner and is the pair's best quality.
